Reactive relay · Checkpoint · Dispatch sequencing · Domain classification
Filters malformed findings: uncitable file:line, missing evidence, structural defects
Findings that pass the barrier enter the immune pipeline below
Classify findings by claim type · Route to verification
Regex pattern matching · Statistical · Logical · Mathematical · Code-Behavioural · Structural
Reads source · Verifies cited bugs exist at cited locations
Claude CLI with file access · AST inspection · 300s timeout
Dedup · Known FP matching · Adaptive-like memory across experiments
Jaccard/TF-IDF · Persistent FP DB · Graduated decay
Domain specialist cells · Class-switching (IgM → IgG) · Each contributes hard gates + effect evidence to S_k
Extracts preconditions → Z3 constraints · Prevents false rejection from context erasure
Confidence-weighted aggregation across all cell types
Asymmetric thresholds: Rejection ≥ 0.6 · Confirmation ≥ 0.4 · Else UNCERTAIN → escalate to HIL
Monitors rejection rate · Prevents immune system attacking its own valid findings
If rejection > 50% OR all findings from one model rejected → autoimmune override (all pass)
Sandbox isolation · Pre/post diff · Ruff · Mypy · Bandit · Pytest
SEARCH/REPLACE application · Target file resolution · Net issue delta
Hard gates (AST, compile) · Effect gates (ruff, mypy, bandit, test) · S* threshold · R_k loop
Carries findings with full provenance between all body systems
OPEN → CONFIRMED → CLOSED · CONTESTED → ESCALATED → HIL
Source model · Round · Verdicts · Severity · Proposed fix · S_k result · Immune verdict
System reaches equilibrium when discovery is exhausted and no contested findings remain
ρ (novelty depletion) · γ (discovery exhaustion) · open_ch (unresolved critical/high) · contested = 0
2 consecutive gate passes required · Burst mode: per-phase convergence then integration
